headline: 428 people arrested in Dhaka in 24 hours during police raids
summary: Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) filed 50 cases against the detainees across various stations in the capital.
details: The Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) arrested 428 people in the last 24 hours during regular operations across the capital city.

caption:
428 arrests in a single day. DMP raids across Dhaka sweep up hundreds of suspects.

According to a DMP press release, the raids were conducted from midnight Wednesday to midnight Thursday.

The arrests were distributed across several divisions: Wari (86), Mirpur (70), Motijheel (65), Uttara (62), Tejgaon (45), Gulshan (39), Lalbagh (33), and Ramna (28).

Police recovered 18.25 kg of marijuana, 2,120 Yaba tablets, 353 bottles of Phensedyl, and 3 grams of heroin during the operations.

Other seized items included 8 mobile phones, three walkie-talkies, a RAB identification card, and a car.

Additional items recovered included a Yaba consumption pipe made from a 10-taka note, foil paper, and a sharp iron cutter.

The DMP stated that legal proceedings against the arrested individuals are currently underway.

headline_marked: Police probe video of [[dogs beaten to death]] in Patuakhali
headline: Police probe video of dogs beaten to death in Patuakhali
summary: A viral video showing two stray dogs being tied to a tree and killed with sticks has triggered widespread outrage and a police investigation.
details: A video purportedly showing two dogs tied to a tree and beaten to death with sticks in Patuakhali's Sadar upazila has gone viral on social media, prompting a police investigation.
The footage shows two men tying the dogs to a tree before repeatedly striking them with sticks until they became motionless.
The incident reportedly took place in the Khejurtala area of Badura village under Auliapur union in Patuakhali Sadar upazila.
Patuakhali District Livestock Officer Md Habibur Rahman stated that the Animal Welfare Act, 2019 makes it a punishable offence to subject animals to unnecessary suffering or kill them cruelly.
Under Section 6 of the law, cruelty towards animals is prohibited, with Section 15 providing for a maximum punishment of six months' imprisonment, a fine of up to Tk 10,000, or both.
Patuakhali Sadar Upazila Nirbahi Officer Rowjatun Jannat and the Officer-in-Charge of Patuakhali Sadar Police Station Md Moniruzzaman confirmed that they are verifying the authenticity of the video.
If the allegations are found to be true, legal action will be taken against those involved in accordance with the law.
caption:
Two stray dogs were tied to a tree and beaten to death with sticks in Patuakhali, as seen in a viral video.

A video purportedly showing two dogs tied to a tree and beaten to death with sticks in Patuakhali's Sadar upazila has gone viral on social media, prompting a police investigation.

The footage shows two men tying the dogs to a tree before repeatedly striking them with sticks until they became motionless.

The incident reportedly took place in the Khejurtala area of Badura village under Auliapur union in Patuakhali Sadar upazila.

Patuakhali District Livestock Officer Md Habibur Rahman stated that the Animal Welfare Act, 2019 makes it a punishable offence to subject animals to unnecessary suffering or kill them cruelly.

Under Section 6 of the law, cruelty towards animals is prohibited, with Section 15 providing for a maximum punishment of six months' imprisonment, a fine of up to Tk 10,000, or both.

Patuakhali Sadar Upazila Nirbahi Officer Rowjatun Jannat and the Officer-in-Charge of Patuakhali Sadar Police Station Md Moniruzzaman confirmed that they are verifying the authenticity of the video.

If the allegations are found to be true, legal action will be taken against those involved in accordance with the law.
